title: fiscal.json
description: Jurisdiction STRUCTURE, not translation (plan §2.2, resolves fiscal blockers F1/F2/F3). Finance/legal-owned; requires a named local finance/legal reviewer. E-invoicing is a structured regime with copy rendered from facts. NO machine-translated fiscal/legal text ever ships. seller_vat_number is verify_from_odoo.

seller_vat_number.description: VAT number of the selling entity.

mandate_status.description: es='b2b_pending' (Crea y Crece B2B awaiting implementing regulation; Verifactu 2026 is certified invoicing, NOT B2B exchange); FR='b2b_phased'; NL='b2g_only'. 'b2b_pending' = B2B mandate legislated but not yet in force.

tolerances.description: Administration-published simplification/tolerance measures for the e-invoicing mandate (FR: mesures DGFiP, incl. report des non-établis à 2027). null where N/A (es/en/nl).

detection_signals.description: Matcher keywords for e-invoicing pain detection.

copy_render.description: Client-facing copy RENDERED FROM the facts above; authored under legal review, never MT.

copy.description: Chart-of-accounts prose. es references PGCE/IVA/balance/PyG/libro mayor/modelos fiscales.

tax_filings.description: Typed, jurisdiction-keyed filing list (NOT a translation of SII/349). ES=SII/SEPA/349; FR=FEC/CA3/EMEBI; NL=BTW-aangifte/ICP-opgaaf.

id.description: Complement/filing id; where it maps to a priced complement, matches registry complements (sii/sepa/modelo_349).

odoo_module.description: Odoo l10n module technical name; DB/version-specific.

late_payment_clause.description: FR REQUIRES this (pénalités de retard); legal defect if omitted where mandated. es=null.

acronyms_fiscal.description: Fiscal acronyms allowed by brand_lint (unioned with shared core + brand_lint.acronyms_extra).
